notes: 📸 Snap your meal: take a photo, add details if you like (amounts, oil, sauces, how much you ate), and the AI splits your plate into foods with portion sizes and macros.
Adjust any portion, set how much you ate, or tell it what to fix and it re-estimates. Log it as one meal or as separate items.
Find it with the 📸 button next to Add food, or at the top of the Add food screen.
